outcome: types and locations of cranial birth injuries
presenting signs and symptoms of cranial birth injuries
timing of presenting signs and symptoms
required treatments for cranial birth injuries
maternal and neonatal factors associated with cranial birth injuries
mode of delivery associated with cranial birth injuries
cohort: 21 term neonates with cranial birth injuries
finding: This retrospective chart review of 21 term neonates with cranial birth injuries found a high rate (43%) of assisted mechanical delivery (forceps and/or vacuum extraction) among the infants, exceeding current practice rates.
mod_finding: The study found that assisted mechanical delivery by either forceps and/or vacuum extraction occurred in 43% of infants with cranial birth injuries.
